name: Team Bulbasaur: Solar Supremacy & League Mastery
archetype: Grass/Fire solar sweeps, Intimidate water pivots, and Levitate hazard immunity.
gym_duel_rationale: The Pokémon League gauntlet requires a full 6-member squad: Venusaur/Charizard melts Lorelei's Ice types and shreds Bruno's Fighting squad; Gyarados/Arbok blunts physical sweepers with Intimidate and counters Lance's dragons with Ice Fang; Alakazam/Weezing provides Levitate Ground immunity and Psychic STAB against Bruno and Agatha; Kingler/Primeape breaks Steel and Normal walls with Crabhammer and Close Combat; Snorlax sponges special blasts from Mew and Agatha's ghosts; and Pidgeot provides Tailwind speed control and Air Slash flinches.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter powerhouse. Resists Fighting and Grass moves while firing devastating Grass and Fire STABs. Destroys Lorelei's Ice types and Blue's Rhydon/Magmortar.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Shuts down physical sweepers upon entry. Dragon Dance boosts Aqua Tail sweeps to dismantle Rock and Ground fusions.
495 BST Levitate sweeper with 118 SpA. Levitate provides Ground immunity. Calm Mind boosts Psychic sweeps against Bruno and Agatha.
500 BST physical wallbreaker. Crabhammer and Close Combat dismantle Steel and Normal types like Bruno's Steelix and Agatha's Snorlax.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Ghost immunity allows it to sponge Agatha's attacks. Rest + Sleep Talk provides infinite longevity against the Elite Four.
High-Speed Flying scout. Immune to Ground moves. Provides team-wide Tailwind speed doubles and reliable Roost healing.

flex_bench.rationale: Accurate Sleep Powder and Quiver Dance setup against slower defensive walls.
High-speed Electric coverage packing Discharge and Light Screen.
High Jump Kick physical breaker with Unburden speed doubling.
